leadText: Saburo Sakaki (Japanese: 榊三郎 Sakaki Saburō) is a character in A Pocketful of Adventures. He is a young designer who worked for Rocket Cosmetics.

Saburo Sakaki (Japanese: 榊三郎 Sakaki Saburō) is a character in A Pocketful of Adventures. He is a young designer who worked for Rocket Cosmetics.
==History==
==Character==
==Names==
 

==Trivia==
Saburo Sakaki's appearance and likeness are based on Giovanni.
It is said in the episode that he has three other brothers, a reference to the Four Rocket Brothers present in the Generation I games .
